question: On which of the following dates is the Global Handwashing Day observed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15 October.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Every year on **October 15, Global Handwashing Day** highlights the significance of handwashing with soap and water at home, in society, and around the world.
